title.en: Match each generation with its key feature

say.en: Your grandparents' first mobile could only make calls. Your phone streams HD video and controls smart devices. Each 'G' was a generation of technology. In this lesson: Describe 1G to 5G.
Match each generation with its key feature.

body.en: 1G (1980s): analog, voice calls only. 2G (early 1990s): digital; added SMS and MMS; technologies GSM and CDMA. 3G (2000s): faster data, *mobile* Internet, video calls. 4G (2010s, LTE): high-speed mobile broadband for HD video streaming and online gaming. 5G: very high speed, very low latency and support for huge numbers of connected devices, enabling IoT, smart cities and remote applications.

points.en: 5G: very high speed, low latency, IoT

narration.en: 1G was analog voice. 2G went digital with SMS. 3G brought mobile Internet. 4G gave high-speed broadband, and 5G adds very low latency for IoT.

title.en: On the board: Five generations of mobile networks

say.en: 1G in the 1980s was analog and carried voice calls only.
2G in the 1990s was digital and added SMS and MMS, using GSM and CDMA.
3G brought mobile Internet and video calls. 4G LTE brought fast broadband for HD video and games.
5G gives very high speed, very low delay, and links huge numbers of devices for IoT and smart cities.

problem.en: Which generation is the minimum needed for each: (i) sending an SMS, (ii) a video call, (iii) streaming HD video smoothly, (iv) thousands of sensors in a smart factory needing instant response?

steps.en: (iii) Smooth HD streaming needs broadband speeds → 4G.
(iv) Massive IoT with very low latency → 5G.

say.en: Let us work through this together. Which generation is the minimum needed for each: i sending an SMS, ii a video call, iii streaming HD video smoothly, iv thousands of sensors in a smart factory needing instant response?
i SMS needs digital service gives 2G.
ii Video calling needs mobile data gives 3G.
iii Smooth HD streaming needs broadband speeds gives 4G.
iv Massive IoT with very low latency gives 5G.
So the answer is i 2G, ii 3G, iii 4G, iv 5G.
